pieces.name: west_block
pieces.notes: West block (garage side, driveway to its south). E-W ridge seen at v about 222 with a clean 45 deg SW hip; north face reads long and shallow (or a stepped lower roof). Big dark north face with many vents.

pieces.name: centre_wing
pieces.notes: Centre wing projects 35 px north of the other eaves; nested V (chevron) hip lines converge on a N-S ridge at u about 185.

pieces.name: east_block
pieces.notes: Upper east block; NE hip line runs from the NE corner to the SW. Ridge direction N-S is a medium-low call.

pieces.name: south_block
pieces.notes: Lower (south) block: lit south face along the whole south eave, E-W ridge. Includes a round bay (dark half-disc at px 527-587, 580-633) on the south wall; left as part of this piece.

notes: Large single-story hip home rotated about 4.7 deg. Trace overshoots the north eave by 35-53 px (navy band); excluded. Four regions: west block (E-W ridge), centre wing (N-S ridge, chevron hip lines), upper east block (N-S, medium-low), south block (E-W, with a round south bay). Shading is inconsistent with one sun direction (oblique capture), so ridge calls lean on hip-line geometry. Confidence medium-low overall; west block ridge position and east block direction are the doubts.
